title: HB10 (2019 1st Extraordinary Session): Modifies provisions relating to the transport and storage of firearms

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official house.mo.gov or senate.mo.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text:
Section 571.030 (RSMo): 3. Subdivision (1) of subsection 1 of this section does not apply to any person nineteen years of age or older or eighteen years of age or older and a member of the United States Armed Forces, or honorably discharged from the United States Armed Forces, transporting a concealable firearm in the passenger compartment of a motor vehicle while the person is in the motor vehicle or when transporting a firearm that is unloaded and in a locked container, so long as such firearm is otherwise lawfully possessed; nor when the actor is also in possession of an exposed firearm or projectile weapon for the lawful pursuit of game; or is in his or her dwelling unit or upon premises over which the actor has possession, authority or control; or is traveling in a continuous journey peaceably through this state if the provisions of subdivision (2) of subsection 6 of this section are met.
Section 571.030 (RSMo): 6. (2) Any firearm, other than a handgun, being transported or stored in a motor vehicle shall be unloaded and stored in a locked case, a locked trunk, or in another type of secure container. A handgun may be transported within the cabin of a motor vehicle as long as it is under the direct control of the person carrying the handgun. If a handgun is left unattended in a motor vehicle, it shall be unloaded and stored in a locked case, locked trunk, or in another type of secure container.
